_comment: Coiffeur row choice (krass_jass/coiffeur_select.py). UNTRAINED: every value here is a first estimate, not a fit. The hand is scored with the Schieber's trump weights (trump_weights.json, edge = score - baseline); a row is worth multiplier x (edge - reserve), where reserve is what the row is expected to fetch if it is kept for a later hand. arena/coiffeur_fit.py is the training run that replaces these numbers.

reserve._comment: Per contract, in Contract order (D, H, S, C, Obenabe, Undenufe): the mean edge of a random hand, 20,000 hands from the shared deal, 2026-10-30. Keeping a row for later is worth an average hand.

joker_reserve._comment: Untrained fallback for the Chance (was the Joker): keeping it is worth the mean of a random hand's BEST contract edge (1.58 over the same 20,000 hands). The fitted points_reserve.CHANCE counts every game.

extra_reserve._comment: The extra rows (krass_jass/schedule.py), in order TUTTI, SLALOM, GUSCHTI, TRIO, MISERE; 20,000 hands from the shared deal, 2026-10-31. A Slalom or Guschti is valued at the mean edge of the contracts its nine tricks are played in; a 3x3 at its first block's edge, the only one known when it is chosen; a Tutti at its best trump suit's edge (TUTTI added 2026-11-01, -0.36); a Misère at minus the edge, since a hand that is bad at Obenabe is good at Misère Obenabe. Keeping the row is worth a random hand's best game in it. Untrained like the rest.

shove_threshold._comment: Shove when the best choice is worth less than this. In Coiffeur a shove hands the choice to an OPPONENT, who gets to fill a row with a hand you have not seen. 0 = shove only when nothing beats keeping the row for an average hand.

value_map._comment: Per game, expected points written = a + b x edge, where edge is the selector's (see value_choices). Fitted on half of coiffeur_games.npz (3000 deals), 2026-11-01, arena/fit_coiffeur.py.

points_reserve._comment: Per row, in points: what a random hand is expected to write in it at its best, under value_map. CHANCE is any game.
